thread:
katie: Heads-up: sketching an approach for tenant->global pool transition without deadlocks or leaking pinned refs. Want quick feedback.

sam: Thanks. TL;DR?

katie: Idea: introduce a 'split-reserve' — a transient reservation object that holds references in both source and target pools during a move. Two-phase: reserve on target, attempt atomic pointer swap, then release on source. Avoids any host-wide locks.

jia: How do we treat pinned pages / kvcache entries? We can't pause user inference to migrate.

matt: Suggestion: only move ranges that are fully unpinned; if pinned, record a lightweight remap entry and leave physical backing in place. Remap table queries handle redirection.

katie: Remap entries are expensive if used a lot. Plan: proactive move only if contiguous free ranges exceed threshold, otherwise remap per-range. Background scanner retries pinned pages later.

olivia: Concern: race on refcounts during swap. split-reserve needs to bump refs on both source and target before swap to avoid ABA/free races.

katie: exact flow we tested in prototype:
```
// pseudo
if (target.reserve(range)) {
  if (atomic_swap_ptr(range, target_ptr)) {
    source.release(range)
  } else {
    target.cancel(range)
  }
}
```

sam: Nice. What about compaction/eviction running concurrently? Compactor might coalesce or move ranges we're operating on.

jia: We can introduce a tiny "move-epoch" that compactor consults: compactor skips ranges with active move epoch. The epoch is per-tenant and quiesce windows should be very short.

matt: Also expose telemetry: move_retries, remap_hits, pinned_skip_ratio. If retries exceed threshold, backoff per-tenant move rate to avoid thrashing.

katie: Operational knobs: max_concurrent_split_reserves per-host, per-tenant_move_rate, and fallback_policy (lazy-copy vs remap). Default conservative.

infra-bot: Feature-flag state: split-reserve-experiment=false

olivia: I'll draft the reservation API: reserve(range)->token, commit(token)->bool, cancel(token). Add retry semantics and gc for stale tokens. Unit tests: race sim + fuzz refcounts + compaction interplay.

katie: :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll open an RFC PR with sequence diagrams, perf numbers from the prototype, and suggested knobs.
